reviews.review_msg: If you have the chance to take this professor, I highly recommend it. She is passionate about what she teaches and how she teaches, she always wants the best for her students, and she always makes sure you understand concepts. If you put in the effort you will do well.
The prof was always available outside class and truly cared about the material. Inspirational stuff.

Professor Aguilera-Moradipour isn't just trying to get through material, but she genuinely cares about your understanding of it. Lectures were always brilliant and made to feel inclusive. She made herself readily available during office hours where I felt it was engaging with me instead of just repeating a lecture.

Great professor with clear expectations. Use the syllabus- she follows it. Stay on top of readings and be engaged in class. She wants you to do well but you need to do the work. Would definitely take her class again.
If you attend, do the readings, participate in class, you'll do well. Really clear expectations and gives good feedback. Cool zine assignment and we all got a copy at the end. Great Prof!

Very little to no valuable feedback was given, comments included no real reflection on the work submitted. Other comments were simple one word statements (ex. 'good', 'great'). Was difficult to understand what the full expectations were as rubrics were not provided or changed between assignments. Content was interesting but lecture lack substance.

Lectures are just her reading out poorly made slides for hours. Get ready to lose grades for something you did not know was being graded because her rubrics are bad or because you didn't do MLA format good. Over half of our class of 12 thought she was a bad teacher. The others probably agree too but I did not get to ask them.
